artifact.summary: Abstained: the recycled-coin coin operator C(m) and its memory-update rule are not given in the abstract or the specification. Any circuit would use an invented coin and would not represent the recycled-coin walk, so no code is emitted.

equation_mapping.explanation: The conditional shift on the cycle is standard coined-walk background. Its direction convention is an assumption, and it is not implemented because the full walk operator cannot be defined without the coin.
U(m)=S(I tensor C(m)) depends on an unspecified placeholder coin. The recycled-coin rule may also need extra memory qubits or non-fixed dynamics, so it cannot be implemented faithfully.
The Born-rule position distribution is a measurement and analysis quantity. The module must be a measurement-free operation, so it is not implemented.
Time averaging is classical post-processing, or a sampling procedure over random t. It is not a unitary operation and is excluded from build_circuit.
This is an input-state preparation for the N=4 instance. The runner prepares inputs, and the circuit must not include state preparation.

specification_changes.change: Narrowed the scope to no implemented construction. No circuit is generated.
specification_changes.reason: The essential recycled-coin operator C(m) and its memory mechanism are unresolved. Implementing a placeholder coin would fabricate the model rather than reconstruct it.

unresolved_issues: Definition of the recycled-coin model and how the coin is reused between steps
Explicit form of C(m) and why m lies in [0,8]
Number of qubits needed for any coin memory
Which parameter values give non-uniform behavior
Details of the related memory-based quantum walk and the proved relationship
